status: prospective observation-only diagnostic; not a settling candidate, support law or original SOL recovery admission
question: Does the post arm worsen packed burial mainly because the unchanged ordinary native granular bearing gate (cyber_native_cell_world.cpp: no bearing impulse or correction when published proxy velocity.y <= 0) suppresses positional correction after Sand has stopped the published velocity?

hypotheses.H_gate: Post suppresses ordinary correction via the vy<=0 gate; first-order lost correction accounts for post's extra tail sink.
hypotheses.H_integration: Post's extra sink is integration-before-Sand independent of the gate; lost correction is small relative to extra sink.
hypotheses.H_schedule: Differences follow Sand acceptance/incoming age, not ordering; examined by the registered acceptance strata.

controls: Fresh World/Rapier session per episode; same source tuples, exact proxy union, unit member mass, native inertia, gravity scale .094, damping, ordinary impulse cap 3 and correction cap .5, Sand planner, age-one gate, drift .25 and energy guards as live-001. No thrust, controls, retuning, native source change or new force law.
only_change: Native World telemetry (physics_diagnostics.enabled) is turned on through a default-off session seam, and a test-only worker subclass copies diagnostic_body_metrics rows plus the exact prepared states and results of EVERY published native tick into a bounded 64-entry mutex ring that the main-thread probe drains once per physics step. Production defaults remain telemetry off.
non_perturbation_control: Each Windows pre/post episode is compared per step with the same host/workers/structure/arm in live-001 by lossless after_step body bits. All 720 equal in all 8 Windows pre/post episodes = NON_PERTURBING_WINDOWS. Otherwise PERTURBATION_UNRESOLVED and the gate conclusion is reported as conditional. Linux and Off are descriptive only (asynchronous schedules).

definitions.applied_result: A consumed snapshot whose ordinary compound result the bridge accepted in that physics step.
definitions.alignment: Diagnostic rows, prepared states and results for an applied_result share snapshot serial, native tick and per-proxy sample serial; misaligned entries are excluded and counted.
definitions.previous_prepare: The ring entry with native tick exactly one less. A missing tick, ring overflow or first entry makes previous_prepare unknown; such results are excluded from counterfactuals and counted.
definitions.supported_proxy: support_samples > 0 in the aligned diagnostic row.
definitions.gated_proxy: supported_proxy whose prepared point velocity y <= 0.
definitions.native_model_check: For supported proxies with 0 < vy <= 4 and known previous_prepare, result correction y must equal -min(.5, .99*max(0, y_now - y_previous)) within 1e-5 cells. Required pass fraction >= .99 per episode, else that episode's counterfactual is INVALID.
definitions.counterfactual_correction: Replace each gated proxy's correction y with -min(.5, .99*max(0, y_now - y_previous)); take the proxy-mass-weighted sum with ungated actual corrections and limit the vector length to .5 as the bridge does.
definitions.lost_correction: Actual applied body correction y minus counterfactual body correction y (cells; positive = upward correction withheld). First-order accounting only; it is not a counterfactual trajectory.
definitions.tail_sink: Mean per-step COM y increase over tail_window steps.
definitions.gate_fraction: Fraction of applied_results with at least one gated_proxy.

pairs: Same host, workers and structure: post minus pre. Eligible if both episodes complete, both counterfactuals valid, post acceptance_fraction >= .5 and post tail_sink - pre tail_sink >= .002 cells/step. Ineligible pairs remain reported in a separate stratum.
ratio: R = (post tail lost_correction per step - pre tail lost_correction per step) / (post tail_sink - pre tail_sink)

decision_rule.H_gate_SUPPORTED: In each structure at least 3 of 4 host/worker pairs are eligible, and every eligible pair has post gate_fraction >= .5, pre gate_fraction <= .2 and .5 <= R <= 2.
decision_rule.H_gate_REJECTED_AS_PRIMARY: In each structure at least 3 of 4 pairs are eligible and R < .5 in at least 3 eligible pairs.

negative_prediction: Off is expected to show low gate_fraction. A SUPPORTED result attributes the post/pre difference; it does not admit post, a support law, a gate change, material-weight calibration or original clearance.
apparatus_smoke: A --smoke run (focused existing gates plus one tree packed post worker1 episode per host) checks capture/alignment/model mechanics only. Its outcomes are excluded from every decision; an apparatus failure is retained, repaired in a new commit and the registered matrix runs fresh afterwards.
authority_limits: No E1/E2, LA/SOL composition, native change, MAT-AUTH or CPU-gate claim. Preserve all historical failures and inherited guard failures. Keep #460 and #461 unchanged and Draft; this branch is a Draft dependent.
